statement: Pinned SDL Wii HIDAPI, Dolphin HIDAPI and Cemu native HIDAPI accept Nintendo 0306 and 0330 identities; SDL, Cemu and kernel still perform separate mapped/unmapped MotionPlus identity and state negotiation. Discovery alone never establishes gyro calibration, F6/40 compatibility or game acceptance; prior Cemu source-based motion export gaps remain separate.

applicability.revision: Original RVL-003, early integrated RVL-036 non-TR, later RVL-036 TR; no physical revision measured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. SDL USB IDs 92-98, SDL HID driver 182-191,385-481; Dolphin WiimoteReal.cpp 1012-1037; Cemu HidapiWiimote 5-48 and provider.cpp 925-950; Linux MP command path 411-567. All proposed physical or host tests are not run.
